notes: The mixed marquee for the beat that is now THE REAL DENTASOURCE, and it carries the candid team frames too: the separate Our people strip was removed on 2026-09-06 and its eighteen tiles were folded in here, so one marquee shows the crew and the work instead of two showing them apart. ORDER RULE: it OPENS ON A VIDEO, and the videos are then SPACED EVENLY through the whole run so the eye keeps changing gear from the first tile to the last. The old rule alternated image, video, image, which was right at fourteen items and wrong at thirty two: strict alternation spends all six clips in the first eleven tiles and leaves a long silent tail. Everything between the clips is a photograph. EXTENDABLE: append either type and re-run the rule.
